name: ae.brainy.tax/uae-tax-rules
title: Brainy Tax — UAE Tax Rules & Deadlines
description: Read-only UAE Corporate Tax, VAT and e-invoicing calculators with official legal citations.

tools.name: uae_einvoicing_dates
tools.description: Compute UAE Accredited Service Provider (ASP) appointment and mandatory e-invoicing go-live dates from annual gross revenue and entity type (MD 243/2025, MD 244/2025, MD 66/2026, MD 197/2026, CD 173/2026).

annual_revenue_aed.description: Total annual gross revenue in AED. Required unless government_entity is true, or b2c_only is true with receives_b2b set to false. Mixed and in-scope B2C-only businesses must include B2C revenue.

b2c_only.description: True only if all sales of the business are exclusively B2C (MD 244/2025 art. 5(2)). Combine with receives_b2b to indicate whether the business receives B2B supplies.

receives_b2b.description: Optional for b2c_only businesses: true if the business buys goods or services from other businesses (receives B2B supplies); false only if it makes exclusively B2C sales and receives no B2B supplies. When omitted or true, B2C-only sellers follow the prudent in-scope path per the FTA e-invoicing FAQ (page updated 17 November 2026); MD 244/2025 art. 5(2) remains the legal text.

government_entity.description: True if the entity is a UAE Government Entity under MD 244/2025 art. 5(1)(c).

tools.name: uae_tax_calendar
tools.description: Generate a 12-month UAE business tax calendar (Corporate Tax return and first-period waiver deadlines, VAT201 deadlines with federal weekend shifts, Small Business Relief assessment, QFZP notices and e-invoicing dates) from a minimal synthetic profile.

financial_year_end.description: Annual financial year-end day and month (for example, { day: 31, month: 12 }).

annual_revenue_aed.description: Annual gross revenue in AED for the evaluated period.

reference_date.description: Optional reference date (YYYY-MM-DD) anchoring the 12-month calendar window [reference_date, +12 months). Defaults to today UTC.

first_ct_period.description: True if the entity is still in its first Corporate Tax period.

first_ct_period_end.description: Explicit end date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the first Corporate Tax period, if known.

registered.description: True if registered for UAE VAT.

period_type.description: FTA-assigned standard VAT return schedule (required when registered is true).

quarter_end_months.description: Four distinct quarter-end months spaced 3 months apart (for example [3, 6, 9, 12]), required when period_type is quarterly.

start_date.description: Optional VAT registration effective start date (YYYY-MM-DD).

is_qfzp.description: True if confirmed Qualifying Free Zone Person; false if confirmed not.

intends_qfzp.description: True if considering Qualifying Free Zone Person election/status.

uae_resident.description: True if UAE Resident Person for Corporate Tax; false if Non-Resident.

excluded_mne_group.description: True if member of a Multinational Enterprise Group excluded from Small Business Relief.

artificial_separation.description: True if artificial separation of business activities applies under MD 73/2023.

items.description: Prior tax-period gross revenue in AED.

prior_revenues_aed.description: Optional gross revenues (AED) of relevant prior tax periods for Small Business Relief evaluation.

sbr_period_start.description: Optional explicit start date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the evaluated SBR period.

sbr_period_end.description: Optional explicit end date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the evaluated SBR period.

b2c_only.description: True only if the business engages exclusively in B2C sales.

receives_b2b.description: Optional for b2c_only businesses: false only if the business makes exclusively B2C sales and receives no B2B supplies; true or omitted follows the prudent in-scope path per the FTA e-invoicing FAQ (updated 17 November 2026).

government_entity.description: True if the entity is a UAE Government Entity.

tools.name: uae_einvoicing_penalty_estimate
tools.description: Estimate UAE e-invoicing implementation administrative penalties under Cabinet Decision No. 173 of 2026, Annex item 1 (initial AED 5,000 plus AED 5,000 per continuing month or part-month, with AED 50,000 rolling 12-month calendar cap), returning full notices (avisos) and out-of-scope reasons (fueraDeAlcance).

violation_date.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the initial e-invoicing implementation breach under Cabinet Decision No. 173 of 2026, Annex item 1.

compliance_date.description: Optional date (YYYY-MM-DD) on which compliance was achieved. Omit if non-compliance is still ongoing as of reference_date.

reference_date.description: Optional reference date (YYYY-MM-DD) used as cut-off when compliance_date is omitted. Defaults to today UTC.

tools.name: uae_vat_credit_expiry
tools.description: Calculate the ordinary 5-year VAT credit deadline and the 31 December 2026 transitional refund or tax/penalty settlement window from the end dates of the original credit-generating VAT periods (no amounts accepted).

items.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the tax period that ORIGINALLY generated the excess VAT credit (not a carry-forward period).

period_closes.description: One or more original VAT credit-generating period end dates (YYYY-MM-DD). No AED amounts are needed or accepted.

tools.name: uae_quick_tax_estimate
tools.description: Estimate UAE Corporate Tax (0% / 9% general bands, Qualifying Free Zone Person rates, or natural-person AED 1,000,000 business turnover threshold), potential Small Business Relief, and VAT registration status.

entity_type.description: Taxpayer profile type: standard UAE company, Qualifying Free Zone Person (qfzp), or individual conducting business (natural_person).

revenue_aed.description: Gross revenue / business turnover in AED for the period (for natural_person, Gregorian calendar-year business turnover excluding wage, personal investment and real estate investment under CD 49/2023).

taxable_income_aed.description: Taxable Income in AED (required when entity_type is company or natural_person; omit for qfzp).

qualifying_income_aed.description: Qualifying Income in AED (required when entity_type is qfzp; omit otherwise).

non_qualifying_income_aed.description: Taxable Income that is not Qualifying Income in AED (required when entity_type is qfzp; omit otherwise).

taxable_supplies_12m_aed.description: Optional value of taxable supplies and qualifying imports over the previous 12 months in AED, to check VAT registration thresholds.

period_start.description: Optional tax period start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to Jan 1 of reference_date year.

period_end.description: Optional tax period end date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to Dec 31 of reference_date year.

reference_date.description: Optional reference date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today UTC.
